title: Pipeline stops at the asset staging step
text:
Pipeline stops at the asset staging step
The nightly asset staging step aborts with a checksum mismatch on a texture atlas.
A half-written atlas from an interrupted previous run is reused because its stamp file survived.
E_ASSET_STAMP_STALE; atlas checksum mismatch

title: Shader cache grows without bound
text:
Shader cache grows without bound
The derived shader cache reaches tens of gigabytes after a few hours of play.
The cache key omits the driver version, so old entries are never evicted.
shader cache entry evicted; cache size over budget

title: Launcher opens behind the splash window
text:
Launcher opens behind the splash window
The launcher window appears underneath the splash overlay and cannot be clicked.
The splash is topmost and only closes on the first paint event, which is delayed.
splash still topmost; launcher not focused

title: Texture streaming hitches on level load
text:
Texture streaming hitches on level load
The first seconds of a level stutter while textures stream in.
The async loading budget is zero in the packaged build.
streaming budget 0; texture group fallback

title: Localization falls back to English
text:
Localization falls back to English
Russian strings render as English after switching the locale at runtime.
The locale change reloads the table but not the already-spawned widgets.
locale table reloaded; missing translation key

title: Save game fails on a path with spaces
text:
Save game fails on a path with spaces
Saving aborts when the profile folder contains a space in its name.
The save path is passed through a shell without quoting.
save path not quoted; E_SAVE_WRITE_FAILED

title: Build server rejects the commit
text:
Build server rejects the commit
The pre-commit hook refuses the commit because the changelog file is missing a section.
The hook checks for a section header that was renamed.
changelog section missing; pre-commit rejected

title: Audio crackles on the second device
text:
Audio crackles on the second device
Sound output crackles after switching the default audio device.
The mixer keeps the old device's sample rate.
mixer sample rate mismatch; audio device lost

title: Editor hangs on import of a large mesh
text:
Editor hangs on import of a large mesh
Importing a mesh over two million triangles freezes the editor for minutes.
The import runs the tangent generation on the UI thread.
import freeze; tangent generation slow

title: Crash when closing the settings dialog
text:
Crash when closing the settings dialog
The application crashes on closing Settings while a preview is loading.
The preview callback outlives the dialog.
use after free preview; settings dialog closed

title: Command line parser eats the first argument
text:
Command line parser eats the first argument
Running the tool with a quoted first argument drops it.
The parser treats the program name as an argument when argv[0] is quoted.
argv parsing dropped; missing first argument

title: Unit test fails only on the CI agent
text:
Unit test fails only on the CI agent
A timing test passes locally and fails on the CI agent.
The test assumes a 16 ms frame; the agent is slower.
flaky timing test; deadline exceeded

title: Database lock holds the writer
text:
Database lock holds the writer
A second writer waits forever while the first holds the index lock.
The lock is taken without a timeout.
database is locked; writer waiting

title: Mail notification repeats the same item
text:
Mail notification repeats the same item
The same inbox item is announced every two minutes.
The read marker is not stored when the notification is shown.
notification repeated; read marker missing

title: Deploy script deletes the wrong folder
text:
Deploy script deletes the wrong folder
The deploy script removes the staging folder instead of the release folder.
The variable for the target is set after the removal.
rm -rf wrong folder; deploy target empty

title: GPU driver reset during a long frame
text:
GPU driver reset during a long frame
The driver resets and the view goes black during a heavy frame.
The command list exceeds the watchdog timeout.
TDR timeout; device removed

title: Package misses the icon file
text:
Package misses the icon file
The installed application shows a blank icon.
The icon is referenced but not included in the installer manifest.
icon missing; installer manifest

title: Search index lags behind writes
text:
Search index lags behind writes
A record written seconds ago is not found by search.
The index updates on a timer and the timer is paused during bulk writes.
index stale; search misses new record

title: HTTPS request fails behind the proxy
text:
HTTPS request fails behind the proxy
Fetching the update manifest fails with a certificate error.
The proxy's root certificate is not in the trust store.
SSL certificate verify failed; proxy root certificate

title: Crash on empty configuration file
text:
Crash on empty configuration file
Starting with an empty config file crashes at once.
The parser dereferences a null table.
empty config crash; null table

title: Memory grows after each scene reload
text:
Memory grows after each scene reload
Resident memory climbs by about 200 MB per reload.
The scene's textures are released after the new scene loads.
memory leak reload; texture refcount

title: Wrong color space in exported screenshots
text:
Wrong color space in exported screenshots
Screenshots look washed out compared with the viewport.
The capture reads the linear buffer and writes it as sRGB.
washed out screenshot; color space conversion

title: Build fails after a clean checkout
text:
Build fails after a clean checkout
A clean checkout cannot build because a generated header is missing.
The header is generated by a step that runs only when the folder exists.
generated header missing; clean build failure

title: Hot reload loses the edited value
text:
Hot reload loses the edited value
Editing a value in the inspector resets after hot reload.
The property is serialized before the edit is flushed.
hot reload reset; inspector value lost

title: Server refuses a client with the same name
text:
Server refuses a client with the same name
Two clients with the same display name cannot both connect.
The name is used as the session key.
duplicate client name; session key collision

title: Timer fires twice at midnight
text:
Timer fires twice at midnight
A daily task runs twice around midnight.
The scheduler compares local time and the daylight-saving shift repeats the hour.
daily task double; daylight saving

title: Path with Unicode fails to open
text:
Path with Unicode fails to open
Opening a folder with a Cyrillic name reports not found.
The path is converted to the ANSI code page.
ENOENT unicode path; ANSI conversion

title: Modal dialog does not block input
text:
Modal dialog does not block input
Clicks pass through the modal dialog to the window behind.
The modal flag is set on the child, not the parent.
modal click through; input not blocked

title: Scroll position resets on refresh
text:
Scroll position resets on refresh
The message list jumps to the top when a new message arrives.
The list rebuilds and clears the scroll anchor.
scroll jump; anchor lost

title: API returns 429 during a burst
text:
API returns 429 during a burst
Bulk indexing receives rate-limit errors.
The client sends every request at once.
429 too many requests; rate limit

title: Wrong working directory in the child
text:
Wrong working directory in the child
A child process cannot find a relative file.
The child inherits the launcher's directory instead of the project's.
child cwd wrong; relative file not found

title: Log file is truncated at startup
text:
Log file is truncated at startup
The log loses the previous session at every start.
The file is opened in write mode before rotation.
log truncated; previous session lost

title: Installer requires elevation twice
text:
Installer requires elevation twice
The installer asks for administrator rights two times.
The uninstaller and installer are separate packages.
elevation twice; uninstaller separate

title: WebSocket reconnects in a loop
text:
WebSocket reconnects in a loop
The live connection reconnects every few seconds.
The server closes the socket after the token expires and the client does not refresh it.
websocket reconnect loop; token expired

title: Font fallback renders boxes
text:
Font fallback renders boxes
Cyrillic text shows empty boxes in the overlay.
The font atlas lacks the Cyrillic range.
font glyph missing; tofu boxes

title: Docker build has no network
text:
Docker build has no network
The image build fails to download dependencies.
The build runs with the network disabled by default.
docker network none; dependency download failed

title: Editor crashes on undo after paste
text:
Editor crashes on undo after paste
Undo after pasting a block crashes the editor.
The undo record references the clipboard buffer that was freed.
undo crash; clipboard buffer freed

title: Wrong counts in the progress bar
text:
Wrong counts in the progress bar
The progress bar shows 0 of 0 while files are processed.
The total is computed after the scan finishes.
p; r; o; g; r; e; s; s;  ; t; o; t; a; l;  ; 0

title: TLS handshake fails on the old OS
text:
TLS handshake fails on the old OS
Connecting from an older OS fails during the handshake.
The client requires TLS 1.3; the OS offers 1.2.
TLS handshake failed; protocol version

title: Duplicate entries after sync
text:
Duplicate entries after sync
The same record appears twice after a sync.
The merge compares titles instead of ids.
duplicate after sync; merge by title

title: Keyboard shortcut stops working
text:
Keyboard shortcut stops working
Ctrl+S stops saving after a dialog opens once.
The shortcut is unregistered when the dialog closes.
shortcut unregistered; Ctrl+S dead

title: Batch file fails with parentheses in the path
text:
Batch file fails with parentheses in the path
A batch step fails when the path contains parentheses.
The path is expanded without quoting inside an if block.
batch parentheses; unexpected token

title: Tests pass but the binary is stale
text:
Tests pass but the binary is stale
Tests pass while the shipped binary still has the old bug.
The test links the fresh object while the binary was not rebuilt.
stale binary; test linked old object

title: Timezone offset ignored in reports
text:
Timezone offset ignored in reports
The report shows times shifted by the timezone.
The timestamp is stored without an offset.
timezone offset missing; report time shifted

title: Package manager resolves the wrong version
text:
Package manager resolves the wrong version
The build picks an older library than the lockfile names.
The lockfile is not used in the CI job.
lockfile ignored; wrong dependency version

title: Read-only file blocks the update
text:
Read-only file blocks the update
The updater fails because a file is read-only.
The previous run marked the file read-only and the updater does not clear it.
read-only file update; access denied

title: Empty table after migration
text:
Empty table after migration
The migrated database has no rows.
The migration commits before copying the rows.
empty table migration; rows not copied

title: HTTP 502 from the gateway
text:
HTTP 502 from the gateway
Requests to the API return 502 during deploys.
The gateway routes to an instance that is still starting.
502 bad gateway; instance starting

title: Search ignores the area filter
text:
Search ignores the area filter
Filtering by area returns records from other areas.
The filter is applied after the limit.
area filter ignored; filter after limit

title: Shutdown waits for a detached child
text:
Shutdown waits for a detached child
Closing the app hangs for a minute.
A child process was started detached and is waited on at exit.
shutdown hang; detached child waited
